source_caption:
🎬 Camelot (2011)

Camelot takes viewers into the legendary world of King Arthur, where political ambition, forbidden love, betrayal, and powerful magic collide in a dangerous struggle for control of Britain. Following the sudden death of King Uther Pendragon, the kingdom faces uncertainty as rival forces compete for the throne. The mysterious sorcerer Merlin reveals that Arthur, a young man raised far from the royal court, is the rightful heir to the kingdom. Unprepared for the enormous responsibilities of leadership, Arthur must learn to become a king while facing threats from powerful enemies who question his legitimacy. Among his greatest opponents is his ambitious half-sister Morgan, a determined and cunning woman who believes the throne rightfully belongs to her. Using political manipulation, dangerous alliances, and supernatural powers, Morgan begins plotting to seize control of the kingdom. Meanwhile, Arthur attempts to unite the divided land under a new vision of justice, loyalty, and peace, surrounding himself with trusted warriors and advisers. His growing attraction to Guinevere introduces emotional complications that threaten both personal relationships and political stability. As rivalries intensify and secrets emerge, the future of Camelot becomes increasingly uncertain. Combining medieval battles, political intrigue, mystical elements, romantic tension, and dramatic storytelling, Camelot explores destiny, ambition, power, loyalty, betrayal, love, and the difficult journey of a young ruler determined to build a legendary kingdom.

🎭 Genre: Fantasy • Drama • Adventure • History

⭐ IMDb: 6.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 50–55 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creators: Chris Chibnall & Michael Hirst

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, and Fandango at Home for current streaming, rental, or digital purchase availability. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Camelot is a fantasy historical drama television series created by Michael Hirst and Chris Chibnall for Starz. An Irish-Canadian co-production, the series is based on the Arthurian legend, and stars an ensemble cast led by Joseph Fiennes, Jamie Campbell Bower, and Eva Green. Camelot premiered on Starz in the United States on 25 February 2011, with a special full-length preview showing of the pilot episode. It then formally premiered on 1 April 2011, and concluded on 10 June 2011, after ten episodes.
